text: Male or female, aged ≥18 years at the time of signing the ICF.
sub_conditions: Age ≥18 years at time of signing ICF

text: Participants with a histologically confirmed diagnosis of NMIBC (Ta, T1 and/or Cis).
sub_conditions: Stage Ta, T1 and/or carcinoma in situ (Cis)

text: During the study, the participants must voluntarily comply with the study-specified cystoscopy, urine cytology and randomized biopsy.

All toxicities caused by prior radiotherapy, chemotherapy or other treatments have recovered to Grade ≤1 (CTCAE 5.0) (except for alopecia), including but not limited to urinary tract infection, urinary tract irritation, and macroscopic hematuria; participants with Grade >1 anti-neoplastic treatment-related toxicities during the screening period may be enrolled after discussion of the investigators and the sponsor.
sub_conditions: Prior treatment toxicities recovered to CTCAE Grade ≤1
Includes urinary tract infection, urinary tract irritation, macroscopic hematuria
Grade >1 toxicities may be allowed after investigator and sponsor discussion

text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0-2.
Expected survival ≥24 weeks.
Hematology: ANC ≥1.5×10^9/L; PLT count ≥75×10^9/L; Hemoglobin (HGB) ≥90 g/L.
Renal function: Creatinine clearance ≥60 mL/min (based on Cockcroft-Gault equation for calculation).
Hepatic function: Serum total bilirubin (TBIL) ≤1.5×ULN; AST and ALT ≤2.5×ULN; Serum ALB ≥30 g/L.
Coagulation function: INR or prothrombin time (PT) ≤1.5×ULN; Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) ≤1.5×ULN.

For women of childbearing potential (WOCBP), the serum pregnancy test prior to the first dose must be negative and the potential participant must promise to use medically acceptable and effective methods of contraception after signing the ICF until at least 6 months after the last dose.
sub_conditions: Negative serum pregnancy test prior to first dose (WOCBP)
Agreement to use effective contraception from ICF signing until at least 6 months after last dose

text: Male participants of child-bearing potential must agree to use medically acceptable and effective methods of contraception after signing the ICF until at least 6 months after the last dose; in addition, male potential participants must agree not to donate sperm during this period.
sub_conditions: Male of childbearing potential agrees to effective contraception from ICF signing until at least 6 months after last dose
Agreement not to donate sperm during this period

text: Participants who understand and voluntarily sign the written ICF and are willing and able to comply with all trial requirements.
sub_conditions: Understands and voluntarily signs written informed consent
Willing and able to comply with all trial requirements

text: Concurrent or prior history of muscle-invasive (muscularis propria) or metastatic bladder cancer.
sub_conditions: Current or prior muscle-invasive bladder cancer
Current or prior metastatic bladder cancer

Prostatic urethra urothelial carcinoma within 24 months

sub_conditions: Radiotherapy within 2 weeks prior to investigational product

Known allergy to any component of T3011 formulation

text: Serious cardiac rhythm or conduction abnormalities.

Coronary angioplasty or stenting within 6 months prior to the first dose of the investigational products.

text: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < lower limit of normal (LLN) of the study site, or <50% if no LLN is set at the site.
sub_conditions: LVEF below site lower limit of normal
LVEF <50% if no site LLN defined

text: Poorly controlled blood pressure.

sub_conditions: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressants

Investigator judgment that fever affects trial participation or efficacy assessment
